items.text:
This looked like a good little game, a bit of a niche game but fun non the less. I've seen people play it and it was something I was looking forward to giving a shot and building my own ship from scrap in a corporate world where everything is working against you.

So I get it, start it up and start a new game - What is the first thing that's shoved in my face on character creation? They/Them Their/Mx pronouns!

Yeah, nothing pulls you out of a fantasy sci-fi game than real world identity politics.

Instantly alt tab closed the game and went to write a review before refunding this, turns out I had to go back in and sit in editor for a bit before steam would allow me to write a review, henceforth the 0.3 hours but I had made my mind up within the first 30 seconds.

You may be wondering why I am so against such things being rammed into games, after all its apparently such a small thing - the very obvious reason is because if you give these people an inch they will take a mile, Dragon Age Veilguard is a perfect example, it starts out with pronouns and before you know it they are full on preaching about ''misgendering'' (A male is a male and a female is a female by the way) and making every virtuous character a collection of pronouns with about 7 different sexuality depending on what day or hour it is and all the bad guys are white straight males.

Message to the developer: I have no idea why you thought it would be a great idea to pander to a 0.01% of the population with sever confusion and identity dysphoria and you actually reinforcing their delusions doesn't make you progressive, it makes you complicit. If you haven't noticed, people are rejecting this ideology in droves and for very good reason, you don't support an alcoholic with more alcohol even though it makes them feel better, you tell them the truth, that its destructive behaviour and needs to be treated. Also put LGBTQ+ tags on this game so it automatically gets filtered out of peoples feeds please, otherwise you are just being dishonest.

Anyways, I'm refunding this game and setting it on my ignore list.
items.text_zh:
这看起来像是一款不错的小游戏，有点小众但依然有趣。我看过别人玩，这是我一直期待尝试的东西，在一个一切都与你作对的企业世界里用废料建造自己的飞船。

所以我懂了，启动它，开始新游戏——角色创建时第一个怼到我脸上的东西是什么？They/Them Their/Mx 代词！

是啊，没有什么比现实世界的身份政治更能把你从奇幻科幻游戏中拽出来了。

我立刻Alt+Tab关掉游戏，准备在退款前写一篇评测，结果发现我得回到游戏里在编辑器里坐一会儿，Steam才允许我写评测，因此显示0.3小时，但我在头30秒内就已经下定决心了。

你可能想知道我为什么这么反对这种东西被硬塞进游戏里，毕竟这 apparently 是件很小的事——非常明显的原因是，如果你给这些人一英寸，他们就会拿走一英里，龙腾世纪：影障守护者就是一个完美的例子，它一开始是代词，不知不觉间他们就开始全力说教关于''错误性别称呼''（顺便说一句，男性就是男性，女性就是女性），把每个道德高尚的角色都变成一堆代词，根据当天或当时是几点拥有大约7种不同的性取向，而所有坏蛋都是白人直男。

给开发者的话：我不知道你为什么觉得迎合那0.01%患有严重困惑和身份烦躁症的人口是个好主意，而你实际上强化他们的妄想并不会让你变得进步，只会让你成为共犯。如果你还没注意到，人们正在成群结队地拒绝这种意识形态，而且有非常充分的理由，你不会用更多酒精去支持一个酗酒者，即使那让他们感觉更好，你会告诉他们真相，那就是这是破坏性行为，需要被治疗。另外请给这款游戏加上LGBTQ+标签，这样它就会自动从人们的推送中被过滤掉，否则你就是在不诚实。

总之，我要退款这款游戏并把它加入我的忽略列表。

observations.description: 角色创建中包含They/Them等代词选项，被认为涉及现实身份政治
